seoTitle: Know Your Body: Voice Pack Archive Edition 01 · The Aletheia Project
description: Archive Edition 01 of the Aletheia Voice Pack: plain, shame-free health education on anatomy, puberty, hormones and periods, with myth-busting and clear signs for when to see a GP.

seoTitle: Find the Words: Voice Pack Archive Edition 02 · The Aletheia Project
description: Archive Edition 02 of the Aletheia Voice Pack: how to notice what’s normal for you, describe symptoms clearly (what, where, when, how much), track patterns and prepare for a GP appointment.

seoTitle: Use Your Voice: Voice Pack Archive Edition 03 · The Aletheia Project
description: Archive Edition 03 of the Aletheia Voice Pack: recognising medical dismissal, preparing for appointments, conversation scripts, navigating Australian healthcare, your rights (consent, confidentiality, interpreters) and inclusive care.

seoTitle: From Voice to Change: Voice Pack Archive Edition 04 · The Aletheia Project
description: Archive Edition 04 of the Aletheia Voice Pack: recognising when individual experiences form a pattern, sharing lived experience safely, and how young people can influence schools, services and policy.

seoTitle: Heard. Understood. Me. The Aletheia Voice Pack (April 2026) · The Aletheia Project
description: The current Aletheia Voice Pack: a youth-designed health literacy and self-advocacy toolkit for young people in Australia. Health words, your symptom story, what to say when you’re dismissed, your rights, and how to turn experience into change.

seoTitle: The Voice Pack Archive · The Aletheia Project
description: Four earlier editions of the Aletheia Voice Pack, showing how our approach to youth health grew from body knowledge to language, self-advocacy and youth-led systems change, and led to today’s Voice Pack.
